{{Quote|All we had in stock were replacements from the Ringneldia, and everything in ''that'' system is standardized around the diameter of some native bean or other.|[[Vuffi Raa]], to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ringneldia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ringneldia II]], the sector's manufacturing center.<ref name="ACGttC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ringneldia was misspelled Rigneldia in [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]].<ref name="ACGttC" />
